name: Kestrel Station
hint: Follow the leading column. Fire into its path and leave room to turn.

name: Ochre Narrows
hint: Cut through an outer column to give the formation a longer trip to the wall.

name: Beacon Field
hint: Watch the gaps between incoming bolts. Move through one gap at a time.

name: Meridian Yard
hint: The ranks sway across your sights. Hold a clear lane and let them cross your fire.

name: Ash Basin
hint: Thin the lowest ranks before they reach your shields. Fire through an opening in the cover.

name: The Downwell
hint: Raiders can dive out of line. Watch the formation behind them when choosing your next shot.

name: Copper Spine
hint: Between dives, follow the outermost column and open up space along the wall.

name: Terminus Array
hint: Aim ahead of the zigzag. Short sidesteps leave you time to fire again.

name: Nightfall Cut
hint: Use the last shield while the crossfire passes. Move clear of its edge to shoot.

name: Cinder Reach
hint: Keep firing into the lowest ranks. Save a clear path sideways for the next volley.
